description:
This trail is designed as a single track Moto cross system of trails. The trail system is maintained by the Northern Dirt Riders/BCORMA affiliation.

The trail is in rough condition & should be navigated with caution.
directions: From Taylor, drive south across the Peace River Bridge heading to Peace Island Park. Turn onto Big Bam Road. Drive 3.7 km to the trailhead.
title: Mud Creek Motorized Trail
